title: Public tracking mirror of a programme (mirror.toml in the programme folder)

repository.description: The GitHub repository that holds the RFCs and their tracking issues (owner/name).

workspace.description: The GitHub repository of the workspace root, for evidence recorded as `workspace`.

phase_rfc.description: The RFC a public task of each phase applies when neither task_rfc nor its title names one.

public_title.description: The title a task shows in the public issue, by task id, when its own title states private facts.

task_rfc.description: The RFC one task applies, by task id; it wins over the title and the phase.
